KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Jibu liko katika kifungu. Tumia kilichoandikwa, si kile unachokijua kutoka nyumbani.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Gives a small detail as the main message.

example.question: Ujumbe mkuu wa hadithi ni upi?

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Puts events in the order they are told in the question, not in the story.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The child does not go back to the story.

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Matukio hupangwa kwa jinsi yalivyotokea katika hadithi. Soma tena kila tukio.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Gives a detail from the passage that belongs to another part of the story.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The child remembers many details and joins the wrong ones.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: A what-or-where question with another detail of the passage as an option.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Find the exact sentence with the action in the passage.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Kifungu kinataja vitu vingi. Rudi kwenye sentensi sahihi ujue jibu linalolingana na swali.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.error: Uses the singular adjective with a plural noun, or the plural with a singular noun (wanafunzi mzuri).
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.cause: English adjectives do not change with number, so the child keeps one form.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.reveals: The question "Wanafunzi ___ walipata zawadi." with "mzuri" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.help: Ask "Wanafunzi ni mmoja au wengi? Kivumishi kinaonyesha nini?"
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.feedback: Kivumishi cha sifa hubadilika kulingana na idadi ya nomino. Wanafunzi wengi, kwa hiyo wazuri.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.error: Uses an adjective with the prefix of another noun class (kitabu mkubwa).
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.cause: The child learned one prefix and uses it for every noun.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.reveals: The question "Kitabu ___ kiko mezani." with "mkubwa" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.help: A gap with a noun of KI-VI and options from other classes.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.feedback: Kivumishi huchukua kiambishi kinacholingana na ngeli ya nomino, kama kitabu kikubwa.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.error: Picks a noun (ukarimu) where an adjective (mkarimu) is needed.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.cause: The child does not yet tell an adjective from the noun made from it.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.reveals: The question "Mkulima ___ alipanda mahindi mengi." with "ukarimu" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.help: Options that include the noun and the adjective of the same word.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.feedback: Kivumishi cha sifa huelezea nomino. Ukarimu ni jina la tabia, si kivumishi.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VYA_SIFA.SIF.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIASHIRIA.VI.error: Uses the singular demonstrative with a plural noun (watoto huyu).
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIASHIRIA.VI.cause: The child matches the class but not the number.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIASHIRIA.VI.help: A plural noun with the singular form among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIASHIRIA.VI.feedback: Kivumishi kiashiria hubadilika kulingana na idadi: kitabu hiki, vitabu hivi.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIASHIRIA.VI.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIASHIRIA.VI.error: Uses a demonstrative of another noun class (mti hii, nyumba huu).
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIASHIRIA.VI.cause: The child has learned the demonstrative of one class by heart and uses it everywhere.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIASHIRIA.VI.reveals: The question "Mawe ___ ni mazito." with "hivi" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIASHIRIA.VI.help: A gap with several classes among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIASHIRIA.VI.feedback: Kivumishi kiashiria huchukua ngeli ya nomino. Mawe ni ya LI-YA, kwa hiyo haya.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIASHIRIA.VI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIASHIRIA.VI.error: Uses the near demonstrative (huyu, hiki) for something far (yule, kile).

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIASHIRIA.VI.help: A sentence with a clue word such as mbali or kule.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIASHIRIA.VI.feedback: Kilicho karibu huonyeshwa kwa huyu, hiki; kilicho mbali kwa yule, kile.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIASHIRIA.VI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIMILIKISH.V.error: Uses the possessive of another noun class (kitabu yangu, mwalimu changu).
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIMILIKISH.V.cause: The child uses the possessive that goes with people for every noun.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIMILIKISH.V.reveals: The question "Kitabu ___ kimepotea." with "wangu" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIMILIKISH.V.help: A gap with a thing noun and options from other classes.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIMILIKISH.V.feedback: Kivumishi kimilikishi hufuata ngeli ya kitu kinachomilikiwa, si ya mwenye kitu.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIMILIKISH.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIMILIKISH.V.error: Uses the singular possessive with a plural noun (vitabu changu).
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIMILIKISH.V.cause: The child matches the class but forgets the number.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIMILIKISH.V.reveals: The question "Vitabu ___ viko mezani." with "chenu" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIMILIKISH.V.help: A plural noun with the singular form among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIMILIKISH.V.feedback: Kitu kikiwa wengi, kivumishi hubadilika: kitabu changu, vitabu vyangu.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIMILIKISH.V.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIMILIKISH.V.error: Uses the possessive of the wrong owner (shule yangu where the owners are we).
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIMILIKISH.V.cause: The child does not match the owner (-angu, -ako, -ake, -etu, -enu, -ao).
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIMILIKISH.V.reveals: The question "Sisi tunapenda shule ___." with "yangu" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIMILIKISH.V.help: A sentence about we or they with -angu among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI_VIMILIKISH.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.error: Uses the greeting or farewell for one person with many (Hujambo for Hamjambo, Kwaheri for Kwa herini).
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.cause: The child learned the greeting for one person and uses it for everyone.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.reveals: The question "Unawasalimia wanafunzi wengi darasani: "___!"" with "Hujambo" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.help: A situation with many people and both greetings among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.feedback: Kwa mtu mmoja tunasema Hujambo na Kwaheri. Kwa watu wengi tunasema Hamjambo na Kwa herini.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.error: Uses a night farewell in the morning or a morning greeting at night.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.cause: The child does not match the greeting to the time of day.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.reveals: The question "Asubuhi unamwamkia mwalimu: "___, mwalimu."" with "Lala salama" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.help: A situation with a clue word such as asubuhi or usiku.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.feedback: Asubuhi tunasema Habari za asubuhi. Usiku tunasema Lala salama au Usiku mwema.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.error: Uses a greeting where a farewell is needed, or a farewell where a greeting is needed (Hujambo when leaving).
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.cause: The child does not ask whether he is arriving or leaving.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.reveals: The question "Unaondoka na kumwaga mtu mmoja: "___!"" with "Hujambo" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.help: A leaving situation with a greeting among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.error: Repeats the greeting (Shikamoo) where the reply (Marahaba) is needed.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.cause: The child does not know the reply is a different word.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.reveals: The question "Mdogo anamwambia mzee "Shikamoo". Mzee anajibu: "___."" with "Shikamoo" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.help: The elder's turn with both words among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.feedback: Mdogo husema Shikamoo kwa heshima, na mzee hujibu Marahaba.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.error: Puts words in order of length, not alphabet.

example.question: Neno gani huja kwanza kwenye kamusi?

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.cause: The child looks for the shortest or the first-looking word.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.help: Say the alphabet and look at the first letter.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.feedback: Kamusi hupanga maneno kwa herufi za alfabeti, si kwa urefu wa neno.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.error: Looks only at the first letter and picks any word with the same first letter.

example.question: Neno gani huja kwanza kwenye kamusi?

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.cause: The child stops at the first letter when two words begin the same.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.reveals: Words that begin with the same letter.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.help: When the first letters match, look at the second letter.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.feedback: Maneno yanapoanza kwa herufi moja, tazama herufi ya pili, kisha ya tatu: sahani huja kabla ya samaki.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.error: Puts the end of the alphabet first.

example.question: Neno gani huja mwisho kwenye kamusi?

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.help: A comes first and Z comes last.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.feedback: Alfabeti huanza na A na kuishia na Z. Neno la mwisho kwenye kamusi huanza na herufi ya mwisho zaidi.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VYA_IDADI.ID.error: Puts the prefix of another noun class on the number (vitabu watatu, wanafunzi viwili).
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VYA_IDADI.ID.cause: The child knows the number words but not that they take the prefix of the noun.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VYA_IDADI.ID.reveals: The question "Vitabu ___ viko mezani." with "watatu" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VYA_IDADI.ID.help: A gap with a thing noun and the people form among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VYA_IDADI.ID.feedback: Nambari moja hadi tano huchukua kiambishi cha ngeli ya nomino: vitabu vitatu.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VYA_IDADI.ID.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VYA_IDADI.ID.error: Writes the bare number (tatu, nne) without the prefix.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VYA_IDADI.ID.cause: In English the number never changes.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VYA_IDADI.ID.reveals: The question "Miti ___ imekatwa." with "nne" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VYA_IDADI.ID.help: Options with the bare number word.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VYA_IDADI.ID.feedback: Nambari moja hadi tano huchukua kiambishi cha ngeli ya nomino. Miti minne.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VYA_IDADI.ID.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VYA_IDADI.ID.error: Adds a class prefix to numbers from six (ng'ombe wasita).
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VYA_IDADI.ID.cause: The child over-applies the rule for one to five.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VYA_IDADI.ID.reveals: The question "Baba ana ng'ombe ___." with "wasita" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VYA_IDADI.ID.help: A sentence with sita, saba or nane.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VYA_IDADI.ID.feedback: Kuanzia sita, nambari haichukui kiambishi cha ngeli: ng'ombe sita, vitabu saba.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VYA_IDADI.ID.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VIULIZI.VIUL.error: Uses the question word of another noun class (vitabu wangapi).
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VIULIZI.VIUL.cause: The child uses the form for people for every noun.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VIULIZI.VIUL.reveals: The question "Vitabu ___ vimepotea?" with "wangapi" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VIULIZI.VIUL.help: A question about things with the people form among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VIULIZI.VIUL.feedback: Kivumishi kiulizi huchukua ngeli ya nomino: wanafunzi wangapi, vitabu vingapi.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VIULIZI.VIUL.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VIULIZI.VIUL.error: Uses the plural question word with one noun, or the singular with many (kitabu vipi).
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VIULIZI.VIUL.cause: The child matches the class but not the number.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VIULIZI.VIUL.reveals: The question "Kitabu ___ ni chako?" with "vipi" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VIULIZI.VIUL.help: A question with one noun and the plural form among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VIULIZI.VIUL.feedback: Kitabu kimoja: kipi. Vitabu vingi: vipi.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VIULIZI.VIUL.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VIULIZI.VIUL.error: Confuses -ngapi (how many) with gani (what kind), or the other way.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VIULIZI.VIUL.cause: The child does not ask what the question wants to know: a number, one of many, or a kind.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VIULIZI.VIUL.reveals: The question "Ulikula chakula ___ jana?" with "wangapi" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VIULIZI.VIUL.help: A question about kind with -ngapi among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VIULIZI.VIUL.feedback: -ngapi huuliza idadi, -pi huuliza ni ipi kati ya nyingi, gani huuliza aina.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_VIVUMISHI_VIULIZI.VIUL.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_KIVUMISHI_KIREJESHI_.A.error: Uses amba- with the ending of another noun class (kitabu ambaye).
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_KIVUMISHI_KIREJESHI_.A.cause: The child uses ambaye for every noun.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_KIVUMISHI_KIREJESHI_.A.reveals: The question "Kitabu ___ nilinunua ni kizuri." with "ambaye" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_KIVUMISHI_KIREJESHI_.A.help: A thing noun with ambaye among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_KIVUMISHI_KIREJESHI_.A.feedback: Amba- huchukua mwisho unaolingana na ngeli ya nomino: kitabu ambacho, mwalimu ambaye.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_KIVUMISHI_KIREJESHI_.A.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_KIVUMISHI_KIREJESHI_.A.error: Uses the singular amba- form for many, or the plural for one (watoto ambaye).
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_KIVUMISHI_KIREJESHI_.A.cause: The child matches the class but not the number.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_KIVUMISHI_KIREJESHI_.A.reveals: The question "Watoto ___ wanasoma ni werevu." with "ambaye" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_KIVUMISHI_KIREJESHI_.A.help: A plural noun with the singular form among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_KIVUMISHI_KIREJESHI_.A.feedback: Mtu mmoja: ambaye. Watu wengi: ambao.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_KIVUMISHI_KIREJESHI_.A.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_KIVUMISHI_KIREJESHI_.A.error: Leaves amba- without its ending (mama amba anauza).

example.question: Mama ___ anauza mboga ni shangazi yangu.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_KIVUMISHI_KIREJESHI_.A.cause: The child knows the stem but not that it needs an ending.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_KIVUMISHI_KIREJESHI_.A.reveals: The question "Mama ___ anauza mboga ni shangazi yangu." with "amba" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_KIVUMISHI_KIREJESHI_.A.help: Options with the bare stem amba.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_KIVUMISHI_KIREJESHI_.A.feedback: Amba- haitumiki peke yake. Ina mwisho: ambaye, ambao, ambacho, ambayo.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T2_KIVUMISHI_KIREJESHI_.A.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T3_MATAMSHI_BORA.VITENDAW.error: Takes a methali for a riddle.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T3_MATAMSHI_BORA.VITENDAW.help: A riddle asks a hidden question and waits for the answer.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T3_MATAMSHI_BORA.VITENDAW.feedback: Kitendawili huficha jibu na humtaka mtu kukitegua. Methali hutoa funzo.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T3_MATAMSHI_BORA.VITENDAW.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T3_MATAMSHI_BORA.VITENDAW.error: Takes a nahau for a riddle.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T3_MATAMSHI_BORA.VITENDAW.cause: Both can be a short phrase.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T3_MATAMSHI_BORA.VITENDAW.help: Can you guess an answer to it?
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T3_MATAMSHI_BORA.VITENDAW.feedback: Nahau ni maneno yenye maana maalum. Kitendawili huuliza kwa mafumbo na kina jibu la kutegua.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T3_MATAMSHI_BORA.VITENDAW.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T3_MATAMSHI_BORA.VITENDAW.error: Takes an ordinary sentence for a riddle.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T3_MATAMSHI_BORA.VITENDAW.cause: The child does not see that a riddle hides the thing it describes.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T3_MATAMSHI_BORA.VITENDAW.reveals: A riddle and a plain sentence.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T3_MATAMSHI_BORA.VITENDAW.help: Does the text name the thing, or hide it?
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T3_MATAMSHI_BORA.VITENDAW.feedback: Kitendawili hakitaji kitu moja kwa moja; hukielezea kwa fumbo. Sentensi ya kawaida inataja wazi.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T3_MATAMSHI_BORA.VITENDAW.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T3_MATAMSHI_BORA.VITENDAW.error: Gives a thing that shares one detail with the riddle but is not the answer.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T3_MATAMSHI_BORA.VITENDAW.cause: The child picks the first thing that comes to mind.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T3_MATAMSHI_BORA.VITENDAW.help: Test each answer against every part of the riddle.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T3_MATAMSHI_BORA.VITENDAW.feedback: Jibu la kitendawili lazima lilingane na kila sehemu yake. Hiyo si jibu sahihi.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T3_MATAMSHI_BORA.VITENDAW.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.error: Takes fast reading for fluent reading, or very slow reading for careful reading.

example.question: Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma ni ipi?
example.correct_answer: Si haraka sana wala polepole sana

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.cause: The child thinks the best reader is the fastest.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.reveals: A question on speed with extremes as options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.help: Ask whether the listener can follow every word.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.feedback: Kusoma kwa ufasaha si kusoma haraka sana. Kasi ifaayo ni ya wastani, ili msikilizaji aelewe kila neno.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.error: Takes a loud voice for a fitting voice.

example.question: Sauti ipasavyo wakati wa kusoma ni ipi?
example.correct_answer: Sauti inayosikika wazi bila kupiga kelele

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.cause: The child thinks louder is better.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.reveals: A question on the voice with shouting and whispering as options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.help: Ask whether the voice is clear and comfortable to listen to.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.feedback: Sauti ipasavyo ni ile inayosikika wazi bila kupiga kelele wala kunong'ona.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.error: Reads on without a pause at the koma and the kikomo.

example.question: Ukifika kwenye koma wakati wa kusoma, ufanye nini?

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.cause: The child reads word after word and does not use the marks.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.reveals: A question on the pause at a koma or a kikomo.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.help: Read the sentence aloud and listen to where the voice rests.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.feedback: Alama za uakifishi zinatuonyesha mahali pa kupumzika: kidogo kwenye koma na kwa muda mrefu zaidi kwenye kikomo.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.M.error: Mixes herufi nzito, mlazo, saizi and rangi.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.M.cause: The child has used the buttons but does not know their names.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.M.reveals: The question "Herufi zinazoegemea upande huitwa herufi ___." with "nzito" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.M.feedback: Herufi nzito zimenenepeshwa, herufi mlazo huegemea upande, saizi ni ukubwa wa herufi.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.M.error: Takes herufi kubwa or ndogo (capital or small letters) for a style such as herufi nzito.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.M.cause: The child thinks big and bold are the same.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.M.reveals: The question "Herufi zilizonenepeshwa huitwa herufi ___." with "kubwa" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.M.feedback: Herufi kubwa ni za mwanzo wa sentensi na majina. Herufi nzito ni zilizonenepeshwa, zinaweza kuwa ndogo au kubwa.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.M.error: Mixes the actions kuhifadhi (save), kuchapisha (print), kufuta (delete) and kufunga (close).

example.question: Kuweka kazi yako salama katika tarakilishi huitwa ___.

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.M.cause: The child does not know what each button does.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.M.reveals: The question "Kuweka kazi yako salama katika tarakilishi huitwa ___." with "kuchapisha" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.M.feedback: Kuhifadhi ni kuweka kazi salama. Kuchapisha ni kutoa karatasi. Kufuta huondoa kazi.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VYA_NAFS.N.error: Picks the pronoun of another person (wewe for mimi, wao for sisi).

example.question: Juma anamwambia Akinyi, "___ ni rafiki yangu."

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VYA_NAFS.N.cause: The child does not ask who speaks and who is spoken to.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VYA_NAFS.N.reveals: The question "Juma anamwambia Akinyi, "___ ni rafiki yangu."" with "Mimi" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VYA_NAFS.N.help: A sentence with speaker, listener and the one spoken about, all in the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VYA_NAFS.N.feedback: Aliye anasema ni mimi, aliye anaambiwa ni wewe, anayezungumziwa ni yeye.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VYA_NAFS.N.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VYA_NAFS.N.error: Uses the singular for many or the plural for one (sisi for mimi, ninyi for wewe).
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VYA_NAFS.N.cause: The child matches the person but not the number.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VYA_NAFS.N.reveals: The question "Mama anamwambia mtoto, "___ unastahili sifa."" with "Ninyi" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VYA_NAFS.N.help: A sentence to one child with the plural pronoun among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VYA_NAFS.N.feedback: Wewe ni mmoja, ninyi ni wengi. Mimi ni mmoja, sisi ni wengi.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VYA_NAFS.N.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VIASHIRI.V.error: Uses the demonstrative of another noun class (Hiki ni mti).
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VIASHIRI.V.cause: The child has learned one form and uses it for every noun.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VIASHIRI.V.reveals: The question "___ ni mti wa mwembe." with "Hii" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VIASHIRI.V.help: A gap with several classes among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VIASHIRI.V.feedback: Kiwakilishi kiashiria hufuata ngeli ya kitu kinachoonyeshwa: mti, huu.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VIASHIRI.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VIASHIRI.V.error: Uses the singular demonstrative for many or the plural for one (Hawa ni mtoto).
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VIASHIRI.V.cause: The child matches the class but not the number.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VIASHIRI.V.reveals: The question "___ ni vitabu vya shule." with "Hiki" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VIASHIRI.V.help: A plural noun with the singular form among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VIASHIRI.V.feedback: Kitu kimoja: hiki. Vitu vingi: hivi.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VIASHIRI.V.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VIASHIRI.V.error: Takes the demonstrative after a noun (kitabu hiki) for the pronoun that stands alone (Hiki ni kitabu).

example.question: Chagua sentensi yenye kiwakilishi kiashiria (kinasimama peke yake).

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VIASHIRI.V.cause: The child sees the word hiki and does not look at whether a noun comes before it.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VIASHIRI.V.reveals: The question "Chagua sentensi yenye kiwakilishi kiashiria (kinasimama peke yake)." with "Kitabu hiki ni kizuri." among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VIASHIRI.V.help: Two sentences with the same word, one with a noun before it.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VIASHIRI.V.feedback: Kiwakilishi husimama mahali pa nomino. Kikifuata nomino, ni kivumishi.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VIASHIRI.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VYA_IDAD.V.error: Uses the number with the prefix of another class (Viwili walichelewa for wawili).

example.question: Wanafunzi kumi walifika. ___ walichelewa. (wawili kati yao)

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VYA_IDAD.V.cause: The child forgets the pronoun takes the prefix of the noun it replaces.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VYA_IDAD.V.reveals: The question "Wanafunzi kumi walifika. ___ walichelewa. (wawili kati yao)" with "Viwili" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VYA_IDAD.V.help: A sentence about people with the form for things among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VYA_IDAD.V.feedback: Kiwakilishi cha idadi huchukua kiambishi cha nomino iliyoachwa: watu, wawili.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VYA_IDAD.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VYA_IDAD.V.error: Writes the bare number (Tatu, Wili) with no prefix.

example.question: Nilinunua vitabu vitano. ___ nilimpa Wanjiru. (vitatu kati yake)

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VYA_IDAD.V.cause: In English the number never changes.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VYA_IDAD.V.reveals: The question "Nilinunua vitabu vitano. ___ nilimpa Wanjiru. (vitatu kati yake)" with "Tatu" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VYA_IDAD.V.help: Options with the bare number word.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VYA_IDAD.V.feedback: Nambari moja hadi tano huchukua kiambishi cha nomino, hata ikisimama peke yake.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_VIWAKILISHI_VYA_IDAD.V.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M_UAK6.error: Ends an exclamation or a command with a full stop or a question mark.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M_UAK6.cause: The child ends every sentence the same way.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M_UAK6.reveals: The question "Lo! Umefika mapema leo!" with "Lo. Umefika mapema leo." among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M_UAK6.help: A sentence of surprise with a full stop among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M_UAK6.feedback: Mshangao, furaha na amri kali huisha kwa alama ya hisi (!).
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M_UAK6.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M_UAK6.error: Writes ng'ombe or ng'ambo without the ritifaa (ngombe).
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M_UAK6.cause: The child does not know the ritifaa marks that ng is one sound.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M_UAK6.reveals: The question "Mkulima ana ng'ombe watano." with "Mkulima ana ngombe watano." among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M_UAK6.help: Options with the word spelt both ways.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M_UAK6.feedback: Ritifaa (') huandikwa baada ya ng katika ng'ombe, ng'ambo, ng'ang'ana.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M_UAK6.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M_UAK6.error: Puts a comma or a full stop where a koloni goes before a list.

example.question: Mama alinunua vitu hivi: mchele, sukari na chumvi.
example.wrong_answer: Mama alinunua vitu hivi, mchele, sukari na chumvi.
example.correct_answer: Mama alinunua vitu hivi: mchele, sukari na chumvi.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M_UAK6.cause: The child does not know koloni introduces a list.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M_UAK6.reveals: The question "Mama alinunua vitu hivi: mchele, sukari na chumvi." with "Mama alinunua vitu hivi, mchele, sukari na chumvi." among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M_UAK6.help: A sentence that announces a list with a comma among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M_UAK6.feedback: Koloni (:) huja kabla ya orodha au maelezo yanayofuata.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M_UAK6.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T4_HESHIMA_ADABU_NA_VYE.H.error: Uses a polite word for the wrong job (asante to ask, pole to thank).

example.question: Ukimwomba mwalimu kalamu unasema, "Mwalimu, nipe kalamu, ___."

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T4_HESHIMA_ADABU_NA_VYE.H.cause: The child knows the words but not what each is for.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T4_HESHIMA_ADABU_NA_VYE.H.reveals: The question "Ukimwomba mwalimu kalamu unasema, "Mwalimu, nipe kalamu, ___."" with "asante" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T4_HESHIMA_ADABU_NA_VYE.H.help: A situation with all the polite words among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T4_HESHIMA_ADABU_NA_VYE.H.feedback: Tafadhali ni kuomba, asante ni kushukuru, samahani ni kuomba msamaha, pole ni kufariji, karibu ni kukaribisha.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T4_HESHIMA_ADABU_NA_VYE.H.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T4_HESHIMA_ADABU_NA_VYE.H.error: Picks the sentence without a polite word, as if a command were polite.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ina heshima zaidi?

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T4_HESHIMA_ADABU_NA_VYE.H.cause: The child does not notice the tone of a command.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T4_HESHIMA_ADABU_NA_VYE.H.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ina heshima zaidi?" with "Nisaidie kubeba mzigo huu!" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T4_HESHIMA_ADABU_NA_VYE.H.help: A request with and without tafadhali or naomba.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T4_HESHIMA_ADABU_NA_VYE.H.feedback: Ombi la heshima lina maneno kama tafadhali, naomba, samahani na asante.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T4_HESHIMA_ADABU_NA_VYE.H.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.USAL.error: Shares a password or a personal detail with a friend or a stranger.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.USAL.cause: The child thinks sharing is friendly.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.USAL.reveals: Safe and unsafe steps for a password.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.USAL.help: Ask who can use your account if they have the password.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.USAL.feedback: Nenosiri ni siri yako. Usimpe mtu mwingine, hata rafiki, ila mzazi au mlezi.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.USAL.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.USAL.error: Opens every link in a message from someone he does not know.

example.question: Ujumbe usiojulikana una kiungo cha zawadi. Ufanye nini?

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.USAL.cause: The child is curious and likes a prize.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.USAL.reveals: An unknown message with a link.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.USAL.help: Ask who sent it and whether you asked for it.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.USAL.feedback: Viungo kutoka kwa watu usiowajua vinaweza kuwa hatari. Mwonyeshe mtu mzima kabla ya kuvifungua.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.USAL.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.USAL.error: Searches on any site and gives details to a site that asks for them.

example.question: Unatafuta kifungu cha kusoma. Utumie tovuti ipi?
example.wrong_answer: Tovuti inayotaka jina na nambari ya simu yangu
example.correct_answer: Tovuti ya shule au maktaba iliyopendekezwa na mwalimu

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.USAL.cause: The child does not ask who runs the site.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.USAL.help: Ask whether the site needs your personal details to read.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.USAL.feedback: Tumia tovuti salama zilizopendekezwa na mwalimu au mzazi, na usitoe maelezo yako binafsi.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.USAL.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_RASMI.BARUA_RASM.error: Puts a part of the letter in the wrong place (salamu for kichwa, tarehe for jina).

example.question: Mada ya barua rasmi huandikwa katika ___ cha barua.

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_RASMI.BARUA_RASM.cause: The child has met the parts but not what each holds.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_RASMI.BARUA_RASM.reveals: The question "Mada ya barua rasmi huandikwa katika ___ cha barua." with "mwili" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_RASMI.BARUA_RASM.help: Parts asked by what they hold.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_RASMI.BARUA_RASM.feedback: Kichwa hutaja mada, salamu humwamkia mwandikiwa, mwili una ujumbe, na mwisho una sahihi na jina.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_RASMI.BARUA_RASM.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_RASMI.BARUA_RASM.error: Puts the sender's address on the left and the receiver's on the right.

example.question: Anwani ya mwandikaji wa barua rasmi huandikwa upande wa ___ juu ya karatasi.

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_RASMI.BARUA_RASM.cause: The child swaps the two addresses.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_RASMI.BARUA_RASM.reveals: The question "Anwani ya mwandikaji wa barua rasmi huandikwa upande wa ___ juu ya karatasi." with "kushoto" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_RASMI.BARUA_RASM.help: Left and right among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_RASMI.BARUA_RASM.feedback: Anwani ya mwandikaji iko juu kulia. Anwani ya mwandikiwa iko kushoto, chini ya tarehe.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_RASMI.BARUA_RASM.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_RASMI.BARUA_RASM.error: Uses the greeting, ending or words of a friendly letter in a formal one.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_RASMI.BARUA_RASM.cause: The child writes to a headteacher as to a friend.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_RASMI.BARUA_RASM.reveals: The question "Mwisho wa barua rasmi huwa "Wako ___,"." with "mpenzi" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_RASMI.BARUA_RASM.help: A formal and a friendly ending among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_RASMI.BARUA_RASM.feedback: Barua rasmi hutumia lugha na maneno ya heshima, kama "Wako mwaminifu,".
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_RASMI.BARUA_RASM.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_RASMI.BARUA_RASM.error: Puts the parts of the letter in the wrong order.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi sahihi wa sehemu za barua rasmi?
example.wrong_answer: Salamu, mwili, anwani, kichwa, tarehe, mwisho
example.correct_answer: Anwani, tarehe, salamu, kichwa, mwili, mwisho

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_RASMI.BARUA_RASM.cause: The child does not picture the page from top to bottom.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_RASMI.BARUA_RASM.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi sahihi wa sehemu za barua rasmi?" with "Salamu, mwili, anwani, kichwa, tarehe, mwisho" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_RASMI.BARUA_RASM.feedback: Barua huanza na anwani na tarehe juu, kisha salamu, kichwa, mwili na mwisho chini.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_RASMI.BARUA_RASM.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.error: Uses li- with a ma- noun because it starts with ma- (maji limeisha).
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.cause: The child learned that ma- goes with li-, which is true only for the plural of nouns that have a singular.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.reveals: The question "Maji ___meisha kisimani." with "li" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.help: Ask "Je, kuna neno jiji, au jimaji?" Maji has no singular.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.feedback: Maji ni ya ngeli ya YA-YA. Hupatana na ya-: maji yameisha.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.error: Uses u-, i-, zi- or vi- with a YA-YA noun.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.cause: The child uses the prefix of the class he knows best.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.reveals: The question "Maziwa ___meichacha jikoni." with "i" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.help: A gap with several prefixes among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.feedback: Nomino za YA-YA hupatana na ya- tu.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.error: Uses a- as for a person or animal (maziwa ameichacha).
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.cause: The child treats the noun like a living thing.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.reveals: The question "Maziwa ___meichacha jikoni." with "a" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.help: A gap with a- among the options for a thing noun.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.feedback: A- ni ya watu na wanyama. Maziwa ni kitu, na hupatana na ya-.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.error: Picks a noun of another class as a YA-YA noun.

example.question: Ni nomino ipi ni ya ngeli ya YA-YA?

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.cause: The child cannot yet tell YA-YA nouns by their agreement.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.reveals: The question "Ni nomino ipi ni ya ngeli ya YA-YA?" with "kitabu" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.help: Options with nouns from different classes.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.feedback: Nomino za YA-YA hupatana na ya- na hazina umoja, kama maji.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_YA_YA.YA_YA.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.error: Reads the methali word for word.

example.question: Mchumia juani hulia kivulini. Maana yake ni nini?
example.correct_answer: Anayefanya kazi kwa bidii hufurahia matunda yake baadaye

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.cause: The child does not know that a methali carries a second meaning.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.reveals: A meaning question with a literal option.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.help: Ask what lesson the methali teaches.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.feedback: Methali haisemi maana yake wazi. Mchumia juani hulia kivulini ina maana kwamba anayefanya kazi kwa bidii atapumzika na kufurahia matunda yake.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.error: Gives the lesson of another methali.

example.question: Haba na haba hujaza kibaba. Maana yake ni nini?
example.correct_answer: Vitu vidogo vikiongezwa polepole huwa vingi

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.cause: The child knows methali but swaps their lessons.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.reveals: The meaning of a different methali as an option.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.help: Ask what the words say about little and little.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.feedback: Kila methali ina funzo lake. Haba na haba hujaza kibaba inafundisha kwamba kidogo kidogo hujaza.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.error: Completes the methali with a word that does not belong to it.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.cause: The child remembers the beginning but not the end.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.reveals: A gap where a plausible wrong ending is an option.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.help: Say the whole methali again from the beginning.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.feedback: Methali hubaki jinsi ilivyo. Mwisho sahihi ni kibaba: haba na haba hujaza kibaba.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI_KUFIKIA_MWIS.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.error: Gives the name of another kind of poem for the number of lines (tathlitha for tathnia).
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.cause: The child has the names but not the numbers behind them.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.reveals: The question "Ubeti wenye mishororo miwili huitwa ___." with "tathlitha" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.help: The number of lines asked with all three names among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.feedback: Tathnia ni mishororo miwili, tathlitha mitatu na tarbia minne. Jina linaonyesha idadi.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.error: Names the kind of a stanza shown without counting its lines.

example.question: Ubeti huu ni wa aina gani? "Mvua imenyesha, / Mito imejaa."

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.cause: The child guesses from the look of the stanza.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.reveals: The question "Ubeti huu ni wa aina gani? "Mvua imenyesha, / Mito imejaa."" with "tathlitha" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.help: A short stanza with the three names among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.feedback: Hesabu mishororo kwanza. Mistari miwili ni tathnia, mitatu ni tathlitha, minne ni tarbia.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.error: Swaps ukwapi (the first part of a line) and utao (the second).

example.question: Kipande cha kwanza cha mshororo wa shairi huitwa ___.

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.cause: The child knows the two names but not their order.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.reveals: The question "Kipande cha kwanza cha mshororo wa shairi huitwa ___." with "utao" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.help: Both names among the options for the first or the second part.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.feedback: Mshororo hugawanyika katika sehemu mbili: ukwapi ni ya kwanza, utao ni ya pili.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.error: Gives vina or mizani for the parts of a line.

example.question: Kipande cha pili cha mshororo wa shairi huitwa ___.

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.cause: The child mixes the parts of a line with its sounds and counts.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.reveals: The question "Kipande cha pili cha mshororo wa shairi huitwa ___." with "vina" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.feedback: Vina ni sauti za mwisho zinazofanana, na mizani ni silabi. Vipande vya mshororo ni ukwapi na utao.
KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.AINA_.error: Takes a text that describes a person (wasifu) for a story (masimulizi).

example.question: Kifungu kinaelezea sura, tabia na maisha ya mtu. Ni insha ya aina gani?

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.AINA_.cause: Both kinds can mention a person.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.AINA_.reveals: Short texts: one describing a person, one telling events.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.AINA_.help: Ask whether the text tells what happened in order, or tells who someone is.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.AINA_.feedback: Insha ya wasifu humwelezea mtu: sura yake, tabia yake na maisha yake. Masimulizi husimulia matukio.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.AINA_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.AINA_.error: Takes a text that explains how something is done (maelezo) for a story.

example.question: Kifungu kinaeleza hatua za kupika uji. Ni insha ya aina gani?

KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.AINA_.cause: The child sees a sequence in both.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.AINA_.reveals: A recipe-like text and a story.
KISW.G6.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_ZA_MAELEZO.AINA_.help: Ask whether the writer says "what happened" or "how to do it".

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_I_I.I_I.M_II_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_LITE.error: Reads the nahau word for word.

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_LITE.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_WRON.cause: The child knows several nahau but swaps meanings.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_WRON.reveals: The meaning of another nahau as an option.

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_WRON.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_WRON.reveals: A nahau gap where a near word is an option.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_WRON.feedback: Nahau hazibadiliki: kukata tamaa, kupiga moyo konde. Neno moja likibadilika, maana hupotea.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_WRON.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_PA_KU_MU.PA_K.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_PA_KU_MU.PA_K.help: Options with u- and i- forms.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_PA_KU_MU.PA_K.feedback: Katika ngeli ya mahali, kitenzi hupatana na mahali (pa-, ku-, mu-), si na nomino.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_PA_KU_MU.PA_K.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_OP.error: Picks the opposite where the same meaning is asked.

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_OP.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_RE.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_LO.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_MI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.error: Reads the words in brackets (what to do on stage) as words a character says.

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA.MNYAMBU.reveals: The question "Mwalimu ___ watoto kuimba wimbo mpya. (huwafanya waimbe)" with "huimbiana" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA.MNYAMBU.help: Options with each ending and a gloss in brackets.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA.MNYAMBU.feedback: -ana ni kila mmoja kwa mwenzake, -isha ni kumfanya mtu atende, na -ua ni kufanya kinyume.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA.MNYAMBU.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.error: Calls formal language informal, or informal language formal.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.cause: The child does not look at who is speaking to whom.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.reveals: The question ""Niaje, msee?" ni lugha ___." with "rasmi" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.help: A greeting between friends and a greeting to a leader.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.feedback: Lugha rasmi ni ya heshima na ya viongozi. Lugha isiyo rasmi ni ya marafiki na nyumbani.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.error: Uses slang or casual words with a teacher, a leader or at a meeting.

example.question: Chagua sentensi inayofaa unapozungumza na mwalimu mkuu.
example.correct_answer: Mwalimu mkuu, naomba ruhusa ya kuondoka mapema.

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.cause: The child uses the way he talks to friends everywhere.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.reveals: The question "Chagua sentensi inayofaa unapozungumza na mwalimu mkuu." with "Nipe ruhusa tu." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.help: A request to a leader with a casual version among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.feedback: Kwa mwalimu, kiongozi au mkutano rasmi tunatumia maneno ya heshima.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.error: Uses very formal words with a friend or a sister at home.

example.question: Chagua sentensi inayofaa unapozungumza na rafiki uwanjani.

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.cause: The child thinks formal words are always better.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.reveals: The question "Chagua sentensi inayofaa unapozungumza na rafiki uwanjani." with "Naomba kibali cha kuanza mchezo." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.help: A friendly invitation next to a formal one.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.feedback: Kwa rafiki au ndugu nyumbani, lugha ya kawaida inafaa. Lugha rasmi kupita kiasi inasikika ya ajabu.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.error: Repeats the word as its own opposite.

example.question: Mfuko huu ni mzito lakini ule ni ___.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.cause: The child does not read the word lakini that signals a contrast.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.reveals: The question "Mfuko huu ni mzito lakini ule ni ___." with "mzito" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.help: A sentence with lakini and the same word among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.feedback: Kinyume ni neno la maana ya upande wa pili, si neno lilelile.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.error: Picks a different adjective that is not the opposite (mdogo for mfupi).

example.question: Mti huu ni mrefu lakini ule ni ___.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.cause: The child picks a word from the same field (size) without checking it is the exact opposite.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.reveals: The question "Mti huu ni mrefu lakini ule ni ___." with "mdogo" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.help: A word with a near neighbour of meaning among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.feedback: Kinyume cha mrefu ni mfupi. Mdogo ni kinyume cha mkubwa.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.error: Gives the opposite without the prefix of the noun (refu for mrefu, jinga for mjinga).

example.question: Kiti hiki ni kigumu lakini kile ni ___.

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.cause: The child changes the opposite to fit the noun when it does not change, or leaves out the prefix when it must.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.reveals: The question "Kiti hiki ni kigumu lakini kile ni ___." with "kilaini" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.help: Options with and without the prefix.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.feedback: Vivumishi vingi huchukua kiambishi cha nomino (mjinga, wachache). Vingine hubaki kama vilivyo (laini, moto).
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VIVUMISH.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.error: Names the wrong animal for the behaviour (kobe for a hard worker).

example.question: Kamau hufanya kazi kutwa nzima bila kuchoka. Kamau ni ___.

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.cause: The child does not link the animal with the behaviour it stands for.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.reveals: The question "Kamau hufanya kazi kutwa nzima bila kuchoka. Kamau ni ___." with "kobe" among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.help: A behaviour with several animals among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.feedback: Kila mnyama hutumika kuonyesha tabia: nyuki (bidii), simba (ujasiri), kobe (polepole), kinyonga (kubadilika), mbweha (ujanja), tausi (kujionyesha).
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.error: Takes a sentence with kama (a tashbihi) for a sitiari.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.cause: The child does not tell the two figures apart.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.reveals: The question "Chagua sentensi iliyo sitiari." with "Mwalimu ni kama simba." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.help: A sitiari and a tashbihi on the same subject.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.feedback: Tashbihi hulinganisha kwa kutumia "kama". Sitiari husema moja ni lingine bila "kama".
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.error: Takes the sitiari word for word (the teacher really has a lion).
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.cause: The child reads the sentence as a plain statement.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.reveals: The question "Chagua sentensi iliyo sitiari." with "Mwalimu ana simba." among the options.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.help: A sitiari beside a sentence with the verb kuwa na.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.feedback: Sitiari haisemi mtu ana mnyama. Inasema mtu ni mnyama kwa tabia yake.
KISW.G6.KUSIKI.T10_SITIARI_ZA_TABIA.SITI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..error: Uses a tense marker (-li-, -na-, -ta-) where a condition marker (-ki-, -nge-) is needed.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..cause: The child knows tenses and not the condition marker.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..reveals: The question "___ kwa bidii, utafaulu mtihani." with "Ulisoma" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..help: A sentence with if in the meaning and tense forms among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..feedback: Sharti linaonyeshwa kwa -ki-, -sipo- au -nge-, si kwa -li-, -na- au -ta-.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..error: Uses -sipo- (do not) where the condition is to do (-ki-).
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..cause: The child does not read the whole sentence for meaning.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..reveals: The question "Wanafunzi ___ pamoja, watamaliza kazi haraka." with "wasipofanya" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..help: A condition whose result only makes sense if it is positive.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..feedback: Soma sentensi nzima. Kama matokeo ni mazuri, sharti ni la kufanya (-ki-).
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..error: Names the tense marker (-ta-) as the condition marker.

example.question: Ni kiambishi kipi cha masharti katika "Ukisoma, utafaulu"?

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..cause: The child finds a marker in the verb but picks the wrong one.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..reveals: The question "Ni kiambishi kipi cha masharti katika "Ukisoma, utafaulu"?" with "-ta-" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..help: A sentence with both -ki- and -ta- and both in the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..feedback: Ta- huonyesha wakati ujao. Ki- huonyesha sharti.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..error: Names the person prefix (u-, a-, ni-) as the condition marker.

example.question: Ni kiambishi kipi cha masharti katika "Angekuja, angeona"?

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..cause: The child picks the first marker in the verb.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..reveals: The question "Ni kiambishi kipi cha masharti katika "Angekuja, angeona"?" with "-a-" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..help: A verb with a person prefix and a condition marker.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..feedback: Kiambishi cha mtu (u-, a-, ni-) hakionyeshi sharti. Sharti ni -ki-, -sipo-, -nge-.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T10_HALI_YA_MASHARTI_NGE..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI_WA_MANENO..error: Only puts si- in front and keeps -ki- (Usikisoma for Usiposoma).
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI_WA_MANENO..cause: The child applies the rule for negating a command or a tense to the conditional.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI_WA_MANENO..reveals: The question "Neno "Ukisoma" likikanushwa huwa ___." with "Usikisoma" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI_WA_MANENO..help: A conditional verb with the si-form among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI_WA_MANENO..feedback: Katika ukanushaji wa masharti, ki- hubadilika kuwa -sipo-: Ukisoma, Usiposoma.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI_WA_MANENO..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI_WA_MANENO..error: Negates with ha- and keeps -ki- (Hukisoma, Hakija).
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI_WA_MANENO..cause: The child applies the rule for negating a tense to the conditional.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI_WA_MANENO..reveals: The question "Neno "Akija" likikanushwa huwa ___." with "Hakija" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI_WA_MANENO..help: A conditional verb with the ha-form among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI_WA_MANENO..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI_WA_MANENO..error: Gives the negative command (Usisome, Asije) for the negative condition.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI_WA_MANENO..cause: The child knows the negative command and uses it for every negative.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI_WA_MANENO..reveals: The question "Neno "Ukisoma" likikanushwa huwa ___." with "Usisome" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI_WA_MANENO..help: A conditional verb with the negative command among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI_WA_MANENO..feedback: Usisome ni amri ya kutosoma. Sharti hasi la Ukisoma ni Usiposoma.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI_WA_MANENO..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..error: Swaps the big form (ji-) and the small form (kiji-).
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..cause: The child learned both forms but not which is for big and which for small.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..reveals: The question "Kitabu kikubwa sana huitwa ___." with "kijitabu" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..help: A big or small noun with both forms among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..feedback: Ukubwa hupata ji-, udogo hupata kiji-. Kijitabu ni kitabu kidogo.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..error: Gives the plain plural (vitabu) where the big or small form is asked.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..cause: The child confuses a big thing with many things.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..reveals: The question "Kitabu kikubwa sana huitwa ___." with "vitabu" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..feedback: Vitabu ni wingi wa kitabu. Kitabu kikubwa sana ni jitabu.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..error: Leaves the noun unchanged (kitabu for jitabu or kijitabu).
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..cause: The child does not see that size changes the noun.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..reveals: The question "Kisu kidogo huitwa ___." with "kisu" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..feedback: Ukubwa na udogo hubadilisha mwanzo wa nomino: kisu, kijisu.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..error: Gives the singular where the plural is asked.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..cause: The child does not read the word wingi.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..reveals: The question "Wingi wa "jitabu" ni ___." with "jitabu" among the options.
KISW.G6.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher
